titulo: What If You Held a Spoonful of a Neutron Star? #shorts
premisa: You're handed one teaspoon of neutron star. It goes from small to enormous in three beats. (1) The weight: NASA puts a sugar-cube-sized piece at about a billion tons, more than all 8 billion humans combined. (2) Your body: you try to lift it and can't, because nothing on Earth could. (3) The planet: you let go, it punches through the floor and bedrock and keeps sinking toward Earth's core. Hard cut on the source star. Draft narration (~65 words, 25 s): 'This spoon weighs more than every human on Earth. Combined. / One teaspoon of neutron star. About a billion tons. / You grip the handle. Your arm doesn't move. No crane on Earth could. / You let go. It doesn't hit the floor. It goes through it. / Through the bedrock. Down toward Earth's core. / The star it came from? Twelve miles wide. It outweighs our Sun.'
gancho: This spoon weighs more than every human on Earth. Combined. (Opening on a regular-looking teaspoon glowing faintly blue on a kitchen table, with the topic clear from the next line: 'One teaspoon of neutron star.')
